intro.title: Polling Hook
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a reusable Vue composable (hook) that performs polling—a technique to fetch data from a server at regular intervals. You will learn how to use Vue's reactive APIs like `ref` and `onUnmounted` to manage state and handle cleanup. The main technologies involved are Vue 3's Composition API and JavaScript's `setInterval` function. By the end, you'll have a custom polling hook that can be integrated into any Vue component to keep data up-to-date automatically.
intro.usecase: Polling hooks are essential for real-time data updates in modern web applications. You'll see them powering live dashboards that display constantly changing metrics like stock prices, server monitoring stats, or social media analytics. They're also crucial for collaborative tools where multiple users need to see synchronized data changes, such as live document editing or team project management boards. As a Vue developer, implementing a polling hook allows you to create responsive interfaces that automatically fetch fresh data without requiring manual user refreshes.
